name: Follow the crypto shorts: Bitfinex BTC shorts vs SMA(50)
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Daily BTCUSD with TradingView BTCUSDSHORTS feed.
entry_long: Daily BTCUSDSHORTS (shorts open interest series) crosses under its SMA(50) -> long ("Shorts Out").
exit: Close when BTCUSDSHORTS crosses back above its SMA(50) ("Shorts In").
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Requires the positioning series from TradingView; data availability may differ today.
